gifts.note: Bring a Grass-type Pokémon. This girl at the east end of Route 123, near Mt. Pyre, gives you the Giga Drain TM when you talk to her with a Grass-type Pokémon in your party (Eggs don't count).

Beat the Lavaridge Gym Leader (Badge 4). After the battle you get the Mega Ring, which lets you Mega Evolve, and TM Package 4 (a set of TMs that go straight into your TM Case). If your Bag had no room, talk to the Leader again.
